overview_description.description: CredibleX develops embedded finance and digital lending infrastructure focused on providing working capital solutions for small and medium-sized businesses. The company enables ecosystem partners, marketplaces, and service platforms to integrate financing products directly into their existing workflows through API-based and white-label solutions. Its financing offerings include revenue-based financing, invoice discounting, receivables financing, payable financing, and short-term business loans designed to support cash flow management. The platform uses digital onboarding and data-driven assessment processes to streamline loan applications, approvals, and fund disbursement for business customers. CredibleX also partners with payment providers, enterprise platforms, and commercial networks to expand access to embedded lending services within business ecosystems. The company operates as a regulated financial services provider supporting SME financing and digital credit infrastructure.
